name: Cloudbrowser REST API
description: Next.js API with Chrome on Fly Sprites, PostgreSQL and Auth0. Billing endpoints require configured Stripe; check billingEnabled. API-key authentication remains supported. The Go CLI manages browsers and links; lifecycle polling is handled internally. Fork requires a paused source.
